comments.content: The Redis image is pinned to a specific Azure Container Registry (dotnetdhmirror-f8bzbjakh8cga6ab.azurecr.io). This appears to be an internal Microsoft mirror. Consider using the official Docker Hub image (redis:7.4) or a public mirror like mcr.microsoft.com/oss/redis/redis:7.4 for better portability and to avoid dependency on internal infrastructure.
